title: JDIT-K Unveils 13.3-Inch 4K2K Rugged TFT Display
summary: JDIT-K released a 13.3-inch 4K2K rugged TFT display featuring a 70,000-hour LED lifetime designed for challenging lighting conditions.

title: Tsubaki KabelSchlepp Introduces Robotrax Cable Carrier System
summary: The Robotrax system features a central steel cable and three-axis flexibility to protect industrial robot cables from severe mechanical stress.

title: Carnegie Mellon Researchers Discover New Hall Effect Form
summary: Scientists discovered an unexpected form of the Hall effect that occurs without a perpendicular magnetic field, overturning a century-old assumption.

title: Texas A&M Researchers Develop Inflatable RoboBall for Lunar Craters
summary: Engineers designed an inflatable robotic sphere called RoboBall to explore inaccessible, steep lunar craters without tipping over.

title: HPE Expands Oracle Collaboration for AI Data Center Networking
summary: Hewlett Packard Enterprise expanded its partnership with Oracle to include multi-year deployments of routing and switching platforms for AI data centers.

title: QuickLogic Expands eFPGA Hard IP for GF 12LP Process
summary: QuickLogic updated its eFPGA Hard IP for GlobalFoundries 12LP with new DSP capabilities, configuration error monitoring, and support for over 250,000 LUTs.

title: MulticoreWare Acquires Semiconductor Design Firm Simulus
summary: MulticoreWare acquired Simulus to integrate FPGA, CXL, and PCIe expertise into its AI and heterogeneous computing offerings.

title: Historic Reedham Swing Bridge Repairs Completed Early
summary: Network Rail completed repairs on the central bearing of the 123-year-old Reedham swing bridge ahead of schedule, restoring full navigation for larger boats.

title: IBM's Amaravati Deployment Boosts India's Quantum Ecosystem
summary: IBM's deployment in Amaravati could help accelerate India's quantum ecosystem as startups develop processors and software.

title: Inline Memory Encryption Needs Integrity for Mission-Critical Data
summary: Aerospace and government systems require confidentiality, authentication, and implementation resilience for off-chip memory.

title: Risks and Challenges in 800VDC AI Data Centers
summary: Higher electrical currents can cause sparks, fires, and costly outages, while hot chips also create operational problems.

title: All-Electric Viceroy Seaglider Completes Maiden Flight
summary: Regent Craft's Viceroy all-electric seaglider combines a floating hull, WIG effect technology, and hydrofoils in its first crewed flight.

title: Cyber Attack on UK Battery Storage Could Trigger Blackout
summary: A report finds that compromising 29 percent of the UK's battery energy storage systems could cause a national blackout.

title: Google Quadruples TPU Roll-Out Cadence
summary: Google has increased its TPU release schedule from once every two years to twice a year.

title: Skeleton and Infineon Collaborate on Power Solutions
summary: Infineon and Skeleton Technologies signed an MoU to develop high-efficiency power solutions for modern datacentres.

title: Nisshinbo Launches Secondary Protection IC for Lithium Cells
summary: Nisshinbo Micro Devices introduced a secondary protection IC for two to four series-connected lithium-ion or lithium-polymer cells.

title: New Qubit Architecture Improves Quantum Operations
summary: A new qubit architecture enables faster and more accurate operations, marking a step toward scalable quantum computers.

title: Robigo Engineers Microbes to Protect Crops Sustainably
summary: Robigo uses biotechnology to engineer microbes to fight pests and reduce reliance on harmful chemical pesticides.

title: Ather Energy Scooter Adopts Car-Like Features
summary: Bengaluru-based Ather Energy released a new electric scooter model incorporating several modern automotive-style features not typically found on two-wheelers.

title: China's Pallas-1 Reusable Rocket Aces Orbit Debut
summary: Galactic Energy's new Pallas-1 rocket successfully reached orbit on its debut launch, though its first stage did not land.

title: Solidworks Introduces Blue Tokens for AI Features
summary: Dassault Systèmes introduced a blue token subscription model to pay for AI usage across the 3DExperience platform.

title: Green Disc+ Bike Chain Lubricant Cuts Waste
summary: The Green Disc+ applies eco-friendly bike chain lubricant directly where needed to eliminate mess and reduce waste.

title: TRACE Framework Brings Explainability to Autonomous Robots
summary: Researchers introduced TRACE, a transparent reasoning architecture designed to provide auditable causal chains and decision-level traceability for autonomous robots.

title: Two-Stage Systems Improve Automatic Audio Mixing
summary: A study on automatic mixing systems demonstrates that separating local balance and global mix coordination significantly improves full-mix quality.

title: Evaluating LiDAR Semantic Segmentation for Real-World Deployment
summary: A new evaluation protocol assesses LiDAR semantic segmentation models under coarse labels, environmental corruptions, and cross-domain shifts.

title: Study Examines Predictive World Models in Robot Control
summary: Researchers analyzed how predictive model evaluation metrics affect robot path-tracking performance under varying sensing and feedback conditions.

title: Guidelines Issued for Power Oscillation Damping Controllers
summary: New implementation guidelines and compliance criteria outline how power oscillation damping controllers in power converters can stabilize large-scale power systems.

title: Dry-Contact Ear-EEG System Monitors ESI Mismatch
summary: Researchers developed a dry-contact Ear-EEG system using a driven-right-leg stimulus for continuous electrode-skin impedance mismatch monitoring and motion artifact cancellation.

title: AIR Adopts Elmo Motion Control for Cargo Aircraft
summary: AIR is integrating Elmo Motion Control's compact servo drives into its uncrewed electric cargo aircraft design.

title: MV-dVRK Benchmark for Spatial Surgical Perception
summary: A new ex-vivo surgical dataset combines multiple synchronized stereo viewpoints with accurate surface geometry and camera poses for spatial perception evaluation.
